about: Visible words per page in <main> on a phone (chromium-mobile), counted by text-budget.spec.ts. The rule is a heading plus at most one sentence per card; setup steps and long explanations sit behind the card's own disclosure. Lower a number when a page gets shorter; raise one only in a reviewed change that says why the words are needed. Measured against a seeded demo record on 2026-11-27 before the ceilings were set. Insights pages are left out: their words are the record's data and model text, not the page's copy.
aboutExplainers: Explainers per route on a phone, counted by text-budget.spec.ts on the e2e-mobile-routes record: visible [data-slot="hint"] (the (i) trigger, the inline Hint) plus free paragraphs, a muted sentence of four words or more written outside a hint or a data row. A route of the height budgets not named here has a budget of 0. The number is exact: lower it when a page gets quieter, raise it only in a reviewed change that names the reason (safety, consent, or an operation that cannot be understood otherwise). Measured 2026-11-28.
